concept: Kinesis Data Streams: multiple consumers, ordering and replay
tests: Choosing a service where multiple independent applications read the same stream in order and can replay data.
expected: Kinesis Data Streams — retains records 1–365 days, ordering within a shard, independent consumers, replay within the retention window. Triggers: "multiple applications read the SAME stream", "in order", "replay the last 24 hours".
why_not: SQS Standard/FIFO delete the message after processing, no replay; SNS is push pub/sub without a stored log.
